title: Add peer-to-peer agent messaging (scripts/msg.sh)
description: Agents can currently only talk along fixed edges: dispatch.sh (->developer), notify.sh (->orchestrator), and debugger.md hand-rolls raw tmux send-keys to reach the tester. Ad-hoc questions between any two roles have no supported path. Add scripts/msg.sh <to-role> <message> that resolves any pane by @role, stamps the sender role from the calling pane, and document it in all four agent files + README.
close_reason: Implemented scripts/msg.sh; documented in all four agent files and README
